title: Concept: Composer requirement that accepts any PHP version
description: composer.json declares a `php` requirement of `*`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `php` requirement of `*`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.json (composer).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `php` requirement of `*`.
